**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

AXXA now works from inside your notes, every change the agent makes can be undone, the agent can read the web when you allow it, Vault Q&A can run fully on your machine, a daily spending limit keeps paid models in check, and the whole interface speaks Portuguese.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **AXXA from your note**: new commands, which you can also put on the mobile editor toolbar.
  - *Ask about this note*, *Summarize this note* and *Send selection to chat*.
  - *Rewrite selection*, *Fix grammar and spelling in selection*, *Translate selection…* and *Continue writing*.
  - Right-click selected text to rewrite, fix, translate or send it to the chat; right-click a note to ask about it or summarize it.
  - Rewrite, fix, translate and continue write straight into the note, and Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes them.
  - In the chat, **+ › This note** attaches the note you have open in one tap.
- **Undo for everything the agent does**: an **Undo** under the answer reverts the whole turn, and each action in the list has its own.
  - It covers edits, new notes, moves (your links are rewritten back), deletes and new folders.
  - If you changed a note by hand afterwards, Undo stops and asks before overwriting.
- **YOLO means YOLO**: in YOLO, deletes run without asking too, because they go to your trash. If Obsidian is set to delete permanently, deletes still ask.
- **The agent on the web**: with **Web access** on (Settings › Agent), the agent can search the web and open public pages.
  - Search uses your own [Tavily](https://tavily.com) key, with 1,000 free searches a month and no card needed.
  - In Ask and Vault, every request shows you the search or the address first. Local addresses are always refused.
- **Vault Q&A without the cloud**: pick an embedding model from your own Ollama (for example `nomic-embed-text`) and indexing and search run entirely on your machine.
- **A daily spending limit**: set it in Settings › Chat › Daily spending.
  - You get a heads-up at 80% and at 100%.
  - Optionally, paid models pause at the limit until midnight; free and local models keep working.
  - **Usage › Left today** shows what's left of the budget.
- **Português**: the whole interface is now available in Brazilian Portuguese. **Same as Obsidian** (the default for new installs) follows Obsidian's language; you can also pick a language in Settings › Chat › Language.

### 🔧 Improvements
- **Left today folds**: each provider shows just its bars until you open it.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **Model names**: sizes no longer merge into versions ("Llama 3.2 11B", not "Llama 3.2.11b"), and Ollama's size tags (`:3b`) stay in the name.
- **OpenRouter embeddings**: *Fetch models* lists OpenRouter's embedding models again, from their new address.

### ⚠️ Compatibility
- Reload Obsidian after updating. Settings migrate automatically.
- If you used AXXA before, the interface stays in English until you pick **Same as Obsidian** or **Português (Brasil)** in Settings › Chat › Language.
- With **Web access** on, the agent can contact `api.tavily.com` (with your key) and the pages it opens. Both are listed in the README's Disclosures.
